page.overview:
Who is Mouser Robots?

Similar to the video games focusing on the 1987 series, Mousers usually show up in the video games focusing on the 2003 series and are often used as an annoyance enemy, having cheap attack tactics and sometimes exploding when left alone, but do have the tendency to be destroyed rather easily. However in some of the 2003 video games, far greater Mousers with advanced capabilities appear.

Mousers are featured as standard enemies, often appearing as enemies in areas that feature . The boss of Dr. Stockman's lab is a , which fires missiles and has arms ending in claws similar to its head. Two Giant Mouser Robots later reappear in area 4 of Stage 6: Justice as mini-bosses. Also featured are Prototype Mousers, which are colored green and being slightly more powerful.

Identical to their previous console appearance, Mousers appear in Skyscraper as some of the first enemies encountered (alongside ). Other modified, stronger versions of the Mouser appear in a number of later areas, including the T.C.R.I building and the sewers of . Another more powerful version of the Mousers, ones with crocodile-like features named Krokodils, appear in the New York Sewers. All three Mouser types appear in the first tournament of tournament mode, and Krokodils also later appear in the Battle Nexus tournament.

Mousers appear in clear boxes in the "Lab" stage, but they serve no direct purpose other than acting identical to the crates available in the game's other stages. Certain levels have Mousers that can spring forth from the ground and act as a distracting nuisance. Another stage features a Giant Mouser Robot chasing the players through the sewers. Also Mousers become playable when you're character dies in Melee Mode you take control of a Mouser but they can't do any damage they're just used to distract opponents by biting them
